question.text: Consider a single chart-eligible streams unit sampled uniformly from the published top ten for Spotify chart-eligible streams in US during 2026-11-13 through 2026-11-19. Which title does that unit belong to? Predict the fraction of actual chart-eligible streams units for each option. These are volume shares, not respondents choosing their favourite or most-watched title. Repeat plays/counting and the publisher definition apply; unlisted titles form the residual.
options: KAROL G - BbY WOW (w/ Judeline, rusowsky)
The Citizens of Halloween - This Is Halloween
All other titles in the published top ten
